The '''Caprioril Massacre''' was the name given to the incident where an [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]], targeting [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Amel Bakli]], reasoned that the most effective way to eliminate its quarry was to kill all 20,000 attendees at a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] race on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Caprioril]]. Swoop racer [[Ignar Ominaz]] also perished in the attack.
